answers.rationale: The requirement specifies a Metal Clad Switchgear lineup with 15kV vacuum circuit breakers, protective relays, and other features. The CROWN-ARMV product matches this description as it is an arc-resistant metal-clad MV switchgear with vacuum circuit breakers and is offered as ETO to meet specific customer requirements.

The requirement specifies compliance with IEEE C37.20.7 Type 2B for arc-resistant switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product is explicitly described as meeting these standards, making it the appropriate choice.

The requirement mentions special tools, maintenance equipment, and spare parts for the Metal Clad Switchgear. The CROWN-ACC product includes accessories and hardware for MV switchgear, which aligns with this requirement.
The requirement involves connection to 13.2 kV feeders, which is within the range of the CROWN-ARMV product. This product is suitable for the specified voltage and application.
